notes: Stories created for Provider Quality Snapshot using existing NPI provider_detail_service. No duplicates introduced.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for provider quality snapshot
Added core logic story for NPI data normalization
Added unit and integration test story

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define structured schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address fields sourced from NPI data.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement NPI Data Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Implement logic to extract required provider quality fields from NPI Registry response and normalize values (e.g., credential formatting, address structuring, license state consistency).

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include provider quality snapshot in provider detail response, ensuring compatibility with existing tool routing and response structure.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Render Provider Quality Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Update frontend message rendering to display provider quality snapshot fields clearly within chat responses, ensuring readability and structured presentation.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Quality Snapshot
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.description: Create unit tests for normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI lookup through facade to frontend rendering.
